vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: trongrid-transaction-info
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides legitimate instructions for an AI agent to query and decode TRON blockchain transactions using the 'trongrid' MCP server. The workflows in SKILL.md and the examples focus on transaction status, resource consumption, and smart contract event decoding without any indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions, required actions, and examples are coherent with its stated purpose of querying and decoding TRON transactions; it does not request unrelated credentials or perform unexpected operations.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the instructions: all calls and decoding steps are TRON-focused (getTransactionById, getTransactionInfoById, solidityGetTransactionById, getContract, getEventsByTransactionId, etc.). Nothing in the manifest asks for unrelated credentials, binaries, or system access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs the agent to call TRON node RPCs and decode transaction/receipt/ABI/event data. It does not ask to read local files, exfiltrate data to external endpoints, or access unrelated system state. Error handling and decoding steps are narrowly scoped.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk or downloaded during install, which is the lowest-risk model.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. This is reasonable for a skill that describes RPC calls to a public TRON node; if you intend to use a paid node provider you may need to supply credentials at runtime, but the skill itself does not request unrelated secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and autonomous invocation is the platform default. The skill does not request persistent or cross-skill configuration or elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: query TRON RPC methods and decode transaction/receipt/ABI/event data. Before enabling, confirm which TRON node or provider the agent will call (public node vs. an API provider that requires keys) and limit any provider API key to least privilege. If the skill later asks for environment variables or to call non-TRON endpoints, treat that as a red flag and re-evaluate.
